provenance.description: Ballistic predictive ZEM/PN expert v2, real rendered-camera detection with declared static lamp-plane and lamp-to-upper-target CAD calibration. Gravity, current drag and finite force response retained. Classical image PN remains an explicit comparison. No measured maximum overload or bandwidth is available.
provenance.command_semantics: Specific force in g, pitch down/yaw right positive. PNG request and attainable control force are distinct. Limit is the combined control-force norm, excluding gravity and passive drag. No automatic gravity compensation. Body forward follows velocity with zero Euler roll.
provenance.parameter_basis: 0.25g is a fixed-envelope assumption near estimated direct 30deg control force 0.246g at launch 16.747m/s; not measured total dart capability or a speed-scaled aerodynamic prediction. Tau0.10s and slew2.5g/s are editable assumptions. 90deg deflection cannot be validated by extrapolating the linear derivative.
